main_text.p: a.1.aEt. ἥξα. aor.1.subj. ἥξω ἧς ἡ, Luc.13.35. ἕως ἂν ἔξῃ scil. ὁ χρόνος. 3.pl. ἥξωσι veniant, Apoc.3.9.
ᵃΗλι ᵇאלי vox Hebraica; Latinè Deus mi, Matth.27.26.
ᵃΗλίκῳς ἡ ον quantus a um, Col.2.1.
ᵃΗλικία ας ἡ statura, aetas, Matth.6.27.

ᵃΗμέρα ας ἡ dies, tempus. per syn.speciei. q.d. ἡμέρα cum aurora fluens. ἡμέρα ὡς, ἡμέρα ἡ aurora. vel ab adj. ἡμερῶν ὁ ἡ mansuetus, quod omnia faciat ἡμέρα. καθ' ἡμέραν quotidie. ἡμέρα κυριακή dies dominicus, Apoc.1.10.
ᵃΗμέτερῶν α ον noster a um. ab ἐγὼ ego. in pl. num. ἡμεῖς nos, 1.Cor.15.31.

ᵃΗμιθνὴς ἐῶν ὁ ἡ feminex, semimortuus a, Luc.10.30. (ex ἡμι semi, quod præfigi solet aliis nominibus, eaque dimidiare, ut semihora ἡμιώρων ν τὸ ein halbe stund. semita q.d. semiiter ἡμιόδιον. Latinum semi est à Graco, ubi spiritus asper mutatur in σ, Gracum vero, ab adj. ἡμισυς. ζωνῆς est ab aor.2. ἔζωον mortuus fui. verbi θνήσκω morior.)
ᵃΗμισυς ἐῶν ὁ, ἡμίσεα εἶας ἡ, ἥμισυ ἐῶν τὸ dimidius a um, Apoc.11.9. ἥμισυ dimidium, Marc.6.23. ἕως ἡμίσεως (pro ἡμισῶν genitivus singul. contractus) usque ad dimidium,
Right margin, cut off: fragments of marginal notes (e.g. "Luc.19.8", "2.Cor.3.13", "1.Tim.2.2", "Hebr. 2.12"), largely illegible.

page.notes: The right margin is cut off at the edge of the scan; its notes are only partly legible and are not transcribed in full. Several Greek words are approximated from the scan and may contain errors. Some Latin abbreviations are uncertain.
